notes: Re-run of hugsim/vad/fullplan-f7d8f9d4b9736ddd-9d698c with Paddock PR #228 (commit 8d37169): VAD base (VAD_base.pth, the released nuScenes checkpoint; VAD 1688c4b) fed the caffe normalisation its weights were trained with (VAD docs/train_eval.md) instead of its config's ImageNet values; every other setting as that campaign. HUGSIM release, the 420 scenarios left of 436 after the 16 the release cannot run (harness.EXCLUDED), driven 21 Nov 2026 to 21 Nov 2026 on one RTX PRO 6000 shared with other users, two lanes sharing one scenario queue (hugsim-eval/queue_420.txt), each lane one paddock node (proc.model_node) served from the PR's worktree; HUGSIM 62c690d run by hugsim_run.py with --fix_heading, --render_cams (the model's six cameras) and --fix_idm_lead; paddock's own bridge (hugsim/bridge.py) from the same commit, sending each plan's whole horizon. Command only. Asked at the declared 2 Hz (every second HUGSIM step), plan held between; its plan is 3 s (6 waypoints 0.5 s apart), all sent. A scenario whose simulator failed before its first step was driven again from scratch; only its scored attempt counts. Runner log: vad-rerun/logs/hugsim.a*.log.
